title: Installation & First App
summary: Install FastAPI, create a minimal app, run it with uvicorn, and explore auto-generated docs.

sections.content: Install FastAPI and uvicorn (the ASGI server). The [standard] extra includes uvloop and httptools for better performance:
For the full stack of dependencies you'll eventually want:

pip install fastapi uvicorn[standard] pydantic pydantic-settings \
    sqlalchemy alembic asyncpg psycopg[binary] \
    python-multipart python-jose[cryptography] passlib[bcrypt] \
    httpx pytest pytest-asyncio redis

sections.title: Key packages
sections.content: python-multipart (forms/uploads), python-jose + passlib (JWT + passwords), asyncpg (async PostgreSQL driver), psycopg (sync PostgreSQL v3).
Create a file main.py with the simplest possible FastAPI app:

items: app = the FastAPI instance inside it

sections.content: You can customize the docs and add metadata:

app = FastAPI(
    title="Task Manager API",
    description="A production-grade task management API.",
    version="1.0.0",
    docs_url="/docs",
    redoc_url="/redoc",
)
You can even add per-route descriptions that show up in the docs:

code_challenge.title: Create a Custom App with Metadata
code_challenge.description: Create a FastAPI app with a custom title 'My API' and a GET /health endpoint that returns {"status": "healthy"}.
code_challenge.starter_code:
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI(title="My API")

hints: Return a dict with 'status' key set to 'healthy'

quiz.question: What does 'main:app' refer to in 'uvicorn main:app'?
quiz.explanation: 'main' is the module (file main.py), and 'app' is the FastAPI instance variable inside that module.

quiz.question: What does the --reload flag do?
options: Auto-restarts the server on code changes
quiz.explanation: --reload watches for file changes and auto-restarts uvicorn. It's for development only — never use it in production.

quiz.question: What is the default URL for Swagger UI?
quiz.explanation: Swagger UI is available at /docs by default. You can customize or disable it via FastAPI constructor params.

quiz.question: Which package is required for handling form data and file uploads?
quiz.explanation: python-multipart is required for parsing multipart form data, which is used for form submissions and file uploads.

quiz.question: How many workers should you use in production?
quiz.explanation: In production, use multiple workers (e.g., uvicorn main:app --workers 4) for concurrency. Never use --reload in production.
